method: Replay every trajectory backward from its final frame while final command, CAL-067 position tolerance, and CAL-068 corrected velocity tolerance are all continuously satisfied. Confirm that every continuous suffix covers the retained 0.15 s candidate.

decision.claim_scope: validated candidate for the current demo; not proven to be the minimum necessary dwell

fit_correction.corrected_behavior: retain the configured candidate only after every passed trajectory covers it under the fitted CAL-067 and CAL-068 thresholds
fit_correction.regression_test: test_motion到位驻留时间要求位置速度同时连续满足

limitations: The acquisition itself used a 0.15 s settling dwell, so this validates that candidate but does not identify a shorter minimum.
The evidence covers the current demo trajectories and maximum 92.4 g demo payload.

post_validation.full_motion_group_regression: deferred until CAL-063 through CAL-070 form a complete group, per operator instruction

downstream.CAL-070: calibrate total settling timeout using observed time from final command to completion of this dwell
